title: AtCoder Crackers
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi has decided to distribute $N$ AtCoder Crackers to $K$ users of as evenly as possible. When all the crackers are distributed, find the minimum possible (absolute) difference between the largest number of crackers received by a user and the smallest number received by a user.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N,K \leq 100$
- All values in input are integers.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N K
```

## Output

Print the minimum possible (absolute) difference between the largest number of crackers received by a user and the smallest number received by a user.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

高桥决定将 $N$ 个 AtCoder 饼干尽可能均匀地分给 $K$ 位用户。分配完所有饼干后，请求出用户收到的饼干数量中的最大值与最小值之差的最小可能值。

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq N,K \leq 100$
- 输入中的所有值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N K
```

## 输出格式

输出用户收到的饼干数量中的最大值与最小值之差的最小可能值。

samples.note: When the users receive two, two and three crackers, respectively, the (absolute) difference between the largest number of crackers received by a user and the smallest number received by a user, is $1$.
The crackers can be distributed evenly.
